noah: let's not overengineer the canary fallback for the MVP — propose a tiny 'fallback proto' for runtime: rule_blob (opaque json), rule_hash, ttl_seconds, probe_endpoint, mode.

esther: ok, what do we need in rule_blob? ops needs reason surfaced.

noah: minimal fields: id, version, mode=hard|soft, compatibility_flags (int), probe_policy {type: "latency_probe"/"smoke" , target: variant_id, sample_rate}, safe_default: route_to (stable), fail_open: true/false

mai: compatibility_flags idea is good — examples: 0x1 tokenization_mismatch, 0x2 kv_incompatible, 0x4 requires_warmup

ops-bot: reminder: any new headers must go through privacy review. Also log size impact.

tomas: probe_endpoint should be a signed short-lived URL (probe_token) that returns structured payload {ok:true, latency_ms, checksum}. runtime caches probe_result for a short window.

kevin: how do we avoid thundering herd on probe? include rate_limit and circuit window; runtime should sample probes by sample_rate. default sample_rate=0.01 for production.

noah: good. telemetry events: fallback.probe_attempt, fallback.probe_result, fallback.triggered. include fields: rule_id, rule_v, variant, reason, probe_latency_ms, sample_rate, rule_hash.

esther: debug header: X-RW-Fallback: reason=probe_fail;rule_v=7;probe_ms=312;mode=soft

mai: soft mode semantics: still route to candidate but mark response meta degraded=true and emit fallback.triggered with severity=low. soft=experiment visibility only.

tomas: fail_open policy discussion: default to fail_open=true so client traffic continues, but ops can opt-in to fail_closed in high-risk routes.

kevin: control plane owns rule generation and versioning. runtime owns enforcement and probe client. console owns visualization/audit trail. ops own SLO thresholds and alerts.

noah: testing: staging job that injects probe_fail and capacity signals for 48h across 5% traffic. We'll run a canary job and collect fallback.* metrics.

esther: doc owners? noah to write short RFC + JSON schema, mai to diagram compatibility flags, tomas to prototype signed probe URL + sample client, kevin to add telemetry mapping.

ops-bot: scheduled: sync meeting 09:30 tomorrow. I created an issue: infra#5123

noah: thanks all. I'll open RFC under docs/rfcs and post link here when ready :pray:
